_comment: Static reference pricing for cost estimation only — not live AWS pricing. The fallback when the live AWS Price List cannot be read. On-demand hourly rates (shared tenancy) for common instance families in the regions this app's VMs use: an entry without an operation field is Linux/UNIX, one with it is the operating system of that EC2 usage operation (RunInstances:0010 RHEL, RunInstances:0002 Windows, RunInstances:000g SUSE; U26-T02). Unresolvable lookups return priceKnown=false rather than guessing. instancePricing is regenerated from the public offer files with scripts/generate-instance-pricing-public.mjs (no credentials; its date and price list version are in instancePricingSource, U26-T03); scripts/generate-instance-pricing.ps1 (AWS Price List API and describe-instance-types) regenerates the specs and RDS rates; instanceTypes holds vCPU, memory and architecture per type, generationUpgradeMap the newer-generation target per architecture (E30-T02). rdsPricing holds RDS rates per engine, DB class, region and deployment (Multi-AZ is twice Single-AZ) and rdsStorageGbMonthRate the RDS gp3 storage rate (E33-T05); the us-east-1 RDS rates were entered by hand from the list prices until the script is run with -Rds.

instancePricingSource.source: https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonEC2/current/region_index.json (public offer files, on-demand, shared tenancy, capacity status Used)
instancePricingSource.operations: no operation = RunInstances (Linux/UNIX); RunInstances:0010 = Red Hat Enterprise Linux; RunInstances:0002 = Windows; RunInstances:000g = SUSE Linux
